settings.content: Two things sit outside all of this, and both matter.
Your eyes. Burning, watering or blurring eyes point to ocular rosacea. That’s for an eye doctor — no cream reaches it, and waiting carries real risk.
Steroid rebound. Redness that started after long steroid use follows a different course. Stopping suddenly is usually worse than the flare, and it needs a doctor’s supervision.
